facts.business: Graphite India Limited manufactures graphite electrodes, graphite equipment, steel, GRP pipes and tanks, and generates hydel power.

guidance_or_targets.statement: EAF based steel production is expected to grow at a faster rate than BOF steel production, resulting in global (excluding China) EAF production capacity increasing at approximately 3% to 4% compounded annual growth rate through 2030, translating into similar increase in demand for UHP graphite electrodes.

key_risks: Unpredictable geopolitics and associated commodity price volatility
Increasing competitive intensity in CPC division
Delay in major projects at customer's end
Steep competition from local competitors in IGE division
facts.related_party_note: Related parties include Emerald Company Private Limited (Immediate and Ultimate Parent Company), Carbon Finance Limited (Wholly Owned Subsidiary), Graphite International B.V. (Wholly Owned Subsidiary), Bavaria Carbon Holdings GmbH, Bavaria Carbon Specialities GmbH, Bavaria Electrodes GmbH (under liquidation), Graphite Cova GmbH, General Graphene Corporation, Godi India Private Limited (Associate), and various other entities and individuals as detailed in Note 38.
